propositions: The moved absence/tombstone cluster in binding_lifecycle.py (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) lacks an integration-tier mutation oracle; its no-churn/change-gating contract is pinned only at unit tier and unreachable on in-window passes.

clear_absent is unreachable on healthy in-window passes because both call sites gate on out-of-window-but-alive keys, and the idempotency fixture seeds every key in-window, making the existing unit-only test insufficient to verify the 02c4 fix.

The bound-but-absent direct GET in run_differs runs through a real backend whose transport 404s for synthetic keys instead of reaching the harness fake, creating a second blocker for testing the full binding lifecycle.

An integration test must verify that out-of-window-but-alive keys reach clear_absent with no mutations, no Jira writes, and an untouched updated_at, such that unconditional timestamp mutations in clear_absent are caught by the oracle.

The test harness must be extended with out_of_window and deleted key sets in _FakeJiraState, 404 behavior for deleted keys, and pre-registration of reconcile_run_differs so the diff-phase backend can use the fake transport.
A second integration test must verify the 404-to-alive round-trip: note_absent records absence with the lifecycle clock sentinel, and clear_absent's clearing branch resets the counter.
